rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for stating your own view or reaction, especially at the end of a sentence.

example.english: Personally, I think this movie is pretty good.
example.traditional: 呢套戲我自己覺得幾好睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 ngo5 zi6 gei2 gok3 dak1 gei2 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this for an explicitly personal opinion or feeling, especially when contrasting it with someone's role or professional relationship.

example.english: Personally, I feel that being a doctor does not mean you have to accept this arrangement.
example.traditional: 我個人覺得，做醫生唔代表一定要接受呢個安排。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 jan4 gok3 dak1 zou6 ji1 sang1 m4 doi6 biu2 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use this when someone does something in person rather than sending somebody else.

example.english: This time, you need to personally explain it to the client.
example.traditional: 你今次要親自去同客人解釋。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 ci3 jiu3 can1 zi6 heoi3 tung4 haak3 jan4 gaai2 sik1
